# Change Verifier

A Muse connector (Streamable-HTTP MCP server + controller UI) that runs seven checks on bank-detail changes — new vendor, changed account, credit limit, direct deposit — says clear, review or block, and holds the change until a named owner accepts it. It is not a payment system: it never touches a bank or ERP. Honest heads-up: the demo tenant is fictional.
